subject.why: The open oyster shell and central pearl are clearly recognisable.

category.why: Features a flat surface and vertical wall matching the category requirements.

clean.why: No text, interface elements, or extraneous characters present.

framing.why: The object is centred with balanced margins on all sides.

colour.why: The shell is muted grey and the backdrop lacks overall warmth and juiciness.

detail.why: Shapes are chunky and clean without distracting micro-textures.

style.why: Smooth 3D volumes with soft lighting match the required game style.

fix: Shift the oyster and background to warmer, brighter tones to make the asset feel more vibrant and juicy.
